    """The truncation strategy to use"""


@dataclass_with_extra
class Text2TextGenerationInput(BaseInferenceType):
    """Inputs for Text2text Generation inference"""

    inputs: str
    """The input text data"""

    """Additional inference parameters for Text2text Generation"""
